title: AI Intelligence & UI Modernization
description: A massive architectural shift towards Shadcn standards, deep AI predictive intelligence, and controlled data mutation workflows.

items.title: Predictive Intelligence
items.description: AI now goes beyond querying to providing data-driven predictions.
details: Confidence scores for AI-generated predictions
Detailed logic and reasoning for every insight
Dedicated 'Insights' tab in the Results Panel
Persistent AI metadata saved within chat history

items.title: Secure AI Data mutations
items.description: Implemented a 'Review & Commit' workflow for AI-driven data edits.
details: Instant mutation review dialog before any data modification
AI-generated 'Transformation Logic' for clear logic transparency
Confirmation-first approach for all SQL/NoSQL edits
Safe execution of complex queries with reasoning

items.title: In-depth Data Summarization
items.description: Comprehensive analysis of query results with a structured report format.
details: Summaries now range from 1 to 5 paragraphs covering trends and outliers
Read Full Report dialog for deep technical summaries
Truncated chat view for improved message readability
Copy-to-clipboard support for full analysis reports

items.title: Direct Data Interaction
items.description: The Data Preview modal is now a fully functional editor.
details: Delete rows directly from the preview with primary key awareness
In-line cell editing with instant persistence and feedback
One-click data reload to sync with backend changes
Multi-row selection for batch operations

items.title: Dynamic Environment Navbar
items.description: Intelligent UI that adapts to the environment it's running in.
details: Native-feel Desktop Navbar for Tauri application mode
Flexible Web Navbar for standard browser usage
Automatic environment detection and component switching
Learn more in the [Introducing Desktop App](/docs/guide/introducing-desktop-app) guide

items.title: Performance: Zero-Lag Resizing
items.description: The Explorer sidebar resizing has been rebuilt for fluid performance.
details: Implemented requestAnimationFrame (rAF) throttling for 60fps interaction
Auto-disabling CSS transitions during active drag to eliminate stutter
Cursor persistence during complex resize operations

items.title: Shadcn Context Menus
items.description: Replaced custom context menus with standardized Radix-based menus.
details: Premium dark-mode aesthetics with glassmorphism effects
Consistent keyboard accessibility and focus management
Context-aware actions for cells, rows, and headers

items.title: State & Reactivity Optimization
items.description: Deep architectural fixes for stable data handling.
details: Refactored Set-based state to ensure immutable updates trigger reactivity
Aligned component props with shadcn v-model standards
Improved primary key heuristics for safe remote data updates
SurrealDB query cleanup and improved parsing logic
